content_sections.heading: About ZSI Project Assistant
content_sections.text: The Zoological Survey of India is under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India. This recruitment is for its research project on coral reef resilience and the impact of climate change in the Gulf of Mannar and Palk Bay, a four-year project funded by the DST–Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF). Applications are handled by the ZSI Sunderban Regional Centre (ZSI-SbRC) at Canning, West Bengal, and the project's Principal Investigator is Dr. J. S. Yogesh Kumar, Scientist-E.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian nationals may apply. The notice prints the following for the single Project Assistant post. Experience in coral reef field surveys Certified SCUBA diver Underwater camera Driving licence Molecular techniques, GIS applications and biostatistics Applicants must be physically fit and willing to undertake extensive fieldwork in remote and logistically challenging areas, including the Gulf of Mannar Islands and the Palk Bay region. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Any Bachelor's degree/ Master's degree in Zoology/ Marine Biology/ Marine Science/ Life Sciences/ Biological Sciences or equivalent from a recognized university

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Project Assistant gets ₹27,000 + HRA; the Hindi version of the notice states this as ₹27,000 + HRA per month. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the duration of the project. The notice does not mention any other allowance. As an additional benefit, the selected candidate will be encouraged to register for a Ph.D. under any recognized university, based on eligibility and institutional affiliation, in line with the research objectives of the project.

content_sections.heading: ZSI Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be temporarily posted in the ZSI-SbRC, Canning, West Bengal and Gulf of Mannar, Tamil Nadu, and will be responsible for: Coral reef underwater survey Live coral and associated fauna status assessment Population density Statistical analysis GIS mapping Molecular study Ecological assessments Conservation of the coral reef, Gulf of Mannar and Palk Bay

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ZSI Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Take the application format enclosed with the notice, or download it from the official website http://www.zsi.gov.in . Fill in the application completely and paste a recent passport size photograph with signature in the box provided. Attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents (educational qualifications, experience certificates, mark sheets, date of birth proof, etc.). Superscribe the envelope clearly with: "Application for the post of Project Assistant under the Coral reef resilience: understanding the impact of climate change in Gulf of Mannar and Palk Bay Project, with kind attention to Dr. J. S. Yogesh Kumar, Scientist-E and Principal Investigator of the project." Send the application by Speed Post/Registered Post to: Officer-in-Charge, Zoological Survey of India, Sunderban Regional Centre, Canning - 743329, West Bengal. Optionally, email an advance soft copy of the application on or before 23 November 2026 to [email protected] and [email protected] . The Hindi version of the form also asks applicants to attach the list of publications separately in APA style and copies of their best three scientific publications.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be informed via email and invited for the interview. The interview will be conducted in hybrid mode (both online and offline) at the Zoological Survey of India, Sunderban Regional Centre, Canning-743329, West Bengal. The date and time of the interview will be communicated separately via email to the shortlisted candidates. A SCUBA diving certificate (Open water and advance open water) is required at the time of the interview. Candidates currently employed in government or semi-government organizations must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ZSI Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) Project Assistant post under the DST–ANRF funded coral reef resilience project in the Gulf of Mannar and Palk Bay.

faq.question: Q2. What is the date for sending the application?
faq.answer: The notice gives 23 November 2026 as the date on or before which an advance soft copy may be emailed to [email protected] and [email protected]; it prints no separate closing date for the postal application.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the ZSI Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Any Bachelor's degree/ Master's degree in Zoology/ Marine Biology/ Marine Science/ Life Sciences/ Biological Sciences or equivalent from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for ZSI Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is as per ZSI norms for Project Assistant as on the date of advertisement, with relaxation as per Government of India norms for SC/ST/OBC/Women and PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of ZSI Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The emoluments are ₹27,000 + HRA, stated as per month in the Hindi version of the notice.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹27,000?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the emoluments as ₹27,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for ZSI Project Assistant?
faq.answer: Send the filled application with self-attested documents by Speed Post/Registered Post to Officer-in-Charge, Zoological Survey of India, Sunderban Regional Centre, Canning - 743329, West Bengal, with the prescribed superscription on the envelope.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email and invited for an interview in hybrid mode (online and offline) at ZSI, Sunderban Regional Centre, Canning.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ZSI Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the duration of the four-year research project.

faq.question: Q10. Is a SCUBA diving certificate needed?
faq.answer: Yes, a SCUBA diving certificate (Open water and advance open water) is required at the time of the interview, and being a certified SCUBA diver is also listed as a desirable qualification.
